subject: IMP kickoff - one multimodal encoder for retrieval
body:
Team,

Kicking off the IMP track for graphs-retrieval. Our open-source MAX & IMP release (alternating gradient descent plus mixture-of-experts for integrated multimodal perception) trains a single model across image, video, and audio - IMP-MoE-B at 90M params posts 83.2 on IN1k, 68.2 on K400 and 88.7 on UCF101, which for one shared encoder is remarkable. For us the prize is multimodal retrieval: one embedding space over all modalities instead of three bolted-together towers.

Scope this window: reproduce IMP-B and IMP-MoE-B from the released experiment configs, then run an IMP-MoE-L-scale training to test whether the retrieval-relevant representations keep improving with scale. Milestones: base repros by end of May, the MoE-L run in early July, findings memo by 2026-07-20.

Csilla leads research, Tereza and Vera experiments, Jorge infra. Bruno - resourcing note please; the MoE-L run is the big compute item and needs booking early.

Anders
